items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: Professor Minetta went around with us, Ralph and I.

ctx.x: Oh they had plenty of mosquitoes. I seen the time we played out there they had to put up a mosquito ball for the band, to keep the mosquitoes from biting the band so we could give the satisfaction to the people that was dancing.

Well while I think of it, the other couple weeks ago we were over across the river taking pictures of all the old halls. Professor Minetta went around with us, Ralph and I. We took pictures of the old places like the Ping Pong on Brooklyn Street. That was probably before your time, back 1905 Eden Fess used to hear music there. But then we wondered about some of those later halls and we went over there near your section I guess where the Elks have their place.
